source_policy: Original accession-specific SEC 10-K/10-Q facts and filing dates; consolidated group earnings; no vendor fallback or later-restatement substitution.
availability_policy: Actual SEC filing dates used conservatively; releases earlier than filings are not assumed.
units: USD million; SEC dollar facts divided by 1,000,000.
eaton_operating_income: Derived operating subtotal = net sales − cost of products sold − selling and administrative expense − research and development expense. Not an issuer-reported consolidated EBIT line. Separate net interest, business-sale gains and other income/expense excluded. Other income/expense includes mixed operating and nonoperating items; this is a disclosed comparability limitation. Alternative pretax+net-interest EBIT is included in facts.json for audit only, not used in scoring.
comparative_policy: Use current-filing prior-YTD comparatives and prior audited annual original values. All 26 interim comparatives compared with original prior-year interims. Only difference: BE nine months 2021 CFO -107.956 million in 2022 Q3 vs -107.907 million in originally filed 2021 Q3. Original FY2021 CFO -60.681 million was filed after original Q3 and remains unchanged in subsequent annuals. Current filing prior-period reclassification statement recorded in raw notes.

validation.method: Independently parse original SEC inline-XBRL context dates, dimensions, numeric scales and signs; compare every SEC companyfacts source fact to the same accession HTML.
validation.independent_review: Solar/fuel recovery agent: all 446 tagged facts, 68 derivations, 336 raw field/component mappings and 36 dates matched; statement excerpts manually checked; no corrections.
